summary.result: All nine reader findings are corrected at every original location. The current reader changes equal the prior report's proposed corrections, with no extra reader text changes. One existing body pass/through error was encountered during the shared-rule impact check and is recorded separately; it is not a regression introduced by these fixes.

included: Every original R1-R9 evidence location and its current SC/TW pair.
All 50 active diagram entries, all 44 example notes, and all 100 paired SC/TW SVG layouts.
Current ordered postprocessing rules, localization tests, malformed-word residuals and independent negative controls.
Bounded impact of the new shared rules on the 25 generated body files, with semantic review limited to the changed lines and the invariant terminology row.
excluded: A new general style review or a new semantic review of unchanged full-book text.
Validation of SC diagram concepts, Python adaptation behavior, source-book claims or reader learning.
Builds, screenshots, rendered geometry quality, interaction testing and final integration.
scope.edits: Only this new follow-up report. The prior report, rules, tests, metadata, SVGs and body Markdown were not edited.
scope.standard: Technical conversion fidelity, preserving meaning and qualifications, not preferred phrasing.

method.readerExtraction: Fresh Python json and xml.etree.ElementTree extraction of all current pairs. Compared against the exact preceding review's retained structured snapshot, not against HEAD or a guessed earlier generation.
method.sourceStability: All 100 SC SVG raw hashes match the prior report. All 32 JSON non-Tw projections match the preceding snapshot, including IDs, anchors, source metadata, source references and example code. All 2589 extracted SC strings are unchanged.
method.metadataProjection: For each JSON file, normalize to an entry list, remove top-level entry keys ending with Tw, then JSON serialize with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True and separators=(',', ':'); SHA-256 its UTF-8 bytes.
method.semanticRecheck: Read every changed full SC/old-TW/current-TW text pair and checked each original evidence fragment at its exact location. The other 2555 reader pairs are byte-identical as strings to the prior reviewed snapshot.
method.ruleBaseline: Reconstructed the old TSV in memory by removing only the new invariant rule/comment and the new late reader-correction block. Its raw SHA-256 exactly matches the TSV hash in the prior report. This establishes that the rest of the ordered rule table did not change.
method.bodyComparison: Applied the hash-verified old rules and current rules to the same current SC body sources in memory, then compared the current-rule result with actual generated body files. This isolates rule effects; it is not a historical raw-body snapshot comparison.
method.locationNotation: A location is repository-relative file#JSON-Pointer or file#XML-path. JSON indices are zero-based. XML sibling indices are one-based by local tag name in the SVG namespace; text() denotes element.text. SC fields remove the terminal Tw suffix; SC SVG filenames remove final -tw.
method.evidenceNotation: sourceExact and currentTwExact are literal contiguous fragments at every listed location. Full changed fields/nodes were also read; the abbreviated evidence is not a back-translation.
